title: Scrap Iron Memorial
logline: A cash-strapped local council is selling a massive disaster memorial for scrap, sparking a bitter conflict with survivors who refuse to let their tragedy be erased.

roles.description: Desperate to balance the budget, views the memorial as a waste of valuable real estate.
Lost family in the disaster, fiercely protective of the site and deeply suspicious of the council.
Bought the salvage rights at a discount, just wants to do the job and get paid.
A massive, beautiful construct of high-grade ferrite, orbiting a silent moon.
A heavily armed patrol cutter loyal to the council's payroll.
The governing body of the system, broke, desperate, and willing to cut corners.

public_situation: The {role:local_council} has announced the decommissioning and sale of the {role:disaster_memorial} to pay off mounting municipal debts, sparking outrage from the survivors.
private_truth: The council isn't just selling the memorial for its metal; the memorial sits on a newly formed stable jump point, and they need it cleared before a corporate surveyor arrives.

beats.public_change: The scrap merchant arrives with heavy cutting lasers, but the equipment keeps failing mysteriously.

missions.reason: The bureaucrat hires the pilot to deliver high-yield mining charges to the memorial to speed up the demolition before the protests grow.
missions.private_fact: The charges are military-grade, meant to obliterate the site completely rather than salvage it.

beats.public_change: The survivors notice the military-grade charges and realise the council is trying to erase something entirely.

missions.reason: The spokesperson begs the pilot to fly close and deep-scan the memorial's foundation before the charges are armed.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals a highly valuable, naturally forming jump point hidden directly beneath the memorial.

beats.public_change: The truth about the jump point leaks. The council panics and sends an armed escort to detonate the charges immediately.

missions.reason: The spokesperson scrambles every credit they have to hire the pilot to destroy the escort before it can trigger the explosives.
missions.private_fact: Mid-fight, the escort captain hails the pilot, offering a massive cut of the jump point's corporate sale price to stand down.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the escort and protects the memorial.
resolutions.summary: The escort is destroyed and the jump point is made public. The survivors claim ownership of the new route, and the council bureaucrat is ousted in disgrace.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew up a council ship to stop them from paving over a disaster memorial.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the bribe and stands down.
resolutions.summary: The pilot takes the bribe and watches the memorial burn. The council secretly sells the jump point rights to a corporation, paying off their debts while the survivors lose everything.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot falsifies the scan report, or ignores the climax.
resolutions.summary: The council detonates the charges without interference, obliterating the memorial and claiming the jump point. The survivors' protests are silenced by the blast.

loose_threads.detail: The mining charges delivered to the memorial have serial numbers matching a naval depot that officially burned down a decade ago.
The jump point's resonance signature was quietly logged in the council's public traffic database six months before the disaster even happened.

radio_hooks: Protests continue at {role:disaster_memorial} over council decommissioning plans.
{role:local_council} promises new infrastructure funding, refuses to specify source.

voice_direction.survivor_spokesperson: Gravelly, exhausted, barely suppressed rage. Never uses the pilot's name, just calls them 'flyer'.
